title: FSM-derived ECM terminal routes - 2005 Nissan 350Z (VQ35DE, all variants)
source: 2005 350Z FSM (Revision 2004 December): EC section, PDF page N = EC-N; LAN section (/workspace/fsm_ref/2005_coupe/lan.pdf, PDF page N = LAN-N); PG section connector faces (PG-26 IPDM, PG-54/55 engine harness, PG-84/85 SMJ).
rules: Every value comes from the FSM. Unknown segments are null with a note; unverified pins are status=pending with a reason.
route = intermediate connectors from the ECM outward; cav is the FSM cavity id; col gives the wire color on each connector half.
map = id of the card in index.html CONN_BASE that depicts the connector (null = not drawn); connectors[map].half says which half's wire color the card shows.
end.type: device (sensor/actuator/module pin), ground (key into ground_points), source (fuse/relay; optional on the map).
sensor_return=true marks ECM sensor-ground terminals (gnd rail returning to the ECM, not to a ground point).
To add ECM wiring to the map: add/extend the pin here first with EC/PG citations; npm test enforces the map against this table.
